semantics.idempotency: EffectIntent and attempt identity must prevent a completed effect from being performed twice.
semantics.unknown_outcome: An ambiguous effect attempt enters UNKNOWN/RECONCILE and cannot be blindly retried.
semantics.cancellation: Cancellation is explicit, observable, and must not erase evidence of already completed effects.
semantics.resume: Resume continues from durable progress without replaying completed effects.
semantics.move: Only explicitly eligible work may move to another worker/node; ownership and attempt identity remain inspectable.
semantics.replay: Replay is an operator-visible diagnostic/recovery action, not a hidden second writer.
